messages.subject: Assigning probabilities for tip ranges
parts:
Hi everyone, 

This might be a dumb question, but I have not found anything similar in the forum or in PhyloWiki, so here it goes. Sorry if it has been asked before!

Is it possible to provide tip ranges as probabilities, instead of fixed values? Particularly when a species occurs in e.g. area A and area B, but it is much more common in A, so perhaps one would like to assign a higher probability of the species being found in A than B.

I realize this is conceptually strange since the species IS found in both areas so the probability of it being found in the range AB is 100% which is what the program technically does. But sometimes the fact that a species is recorded from both areas, even by very few individuals in one of them, bias the estimates in some counter-intuitive ways, so perhaps assigning different probabilities to each area could fix this?

Thanks and best,
Ivan
